description: Raw-deflate Python payload wrapper for the geometry-suffix ordering package. Keeps the same backend, dictionary, and transform code as the parent while reducing counted source bytes.

build.packaging: 71-byte zlib loader plus raw-deflate Python transform payload.

basis: The decompressed Python body is byte-for-byte the parent program.py; backend and dictionary payloads are unchanged.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary

10m_lzma_proxy.basis: No-lock page_order_screen.py proxy over reordered raw XML, not a Hutter score.

verdict: High-priority exact scorer candidate. This is the smallest suffix package and has the best 10M no-lock ordering proxy, but no exact cmix backend gate is recorded yet.
